verdict.rationale: AMD docs confirm core/thread count (up to 32 threads) and boost tuning via PBO/Ryzen Master, and independent reviews (TechPowerup, Tom's Hardware) corroborate strong productivity performance alongside class-leading gaming benchmarks. However, evidence lacks explicit compile-time or multi-threaded workload benchmarks (e.g., Cinebench multi-core, code build times) to directly validate 'compile big codebases' claims. Missing for 10: explicit multi-core/compile benchmark numbers, detailed core/thread topology breakdown, independent parallel-workload testing beyond general productivity mentions.
